title: Hunyuan-TurboS: Advancing Large Language Models through Mamba-Transformer Synergy and Adaptive Chain-of-Thought
paper_type_zh: 前沿推理模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理后训练数据、反馈组件与披露边界的读者
one_line: Hunyuan-TurboS reports 16T pre-training tokens, 3M SFT samples, adaptive teacher-generated traces, about 200K human preference labels, more than 800K executable code samples, and 300K plus 160K two-stage GRPO inputs, but releases no training corpus, weights, construction code, reward checkpoints, or replay ledger.
Hunyuan-TurboS 报告 300 万条 SFT 指令、自适应长短 CoT、人工标注 GRM、代码沙箱反馈和两阶段 GRPO，但未公开来源 manifest 与多数关键复现配置。
why: It shows how a frontier report can disclose substantial stage-level data and feedback contracts while a hosted model demo and report repository remain fundamentally different from open weights, reusable data, and a reproducible training pipeline.
inclusion_reason: Hunyuan-TurboS is a useful frontier disclosure because it reports separate pre-training, SFT, adaptive-teacher, deliberation, GRM, executable-code, and two-stage GRPO objects, while its official artifacts also make the absence of open weights, datasets, training code, and replay metadata auditable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A frontier model report can expose substantial training detail while still withholding the reusable objects needed for independent audit. Hunyuan-TurboS therefore needs four separate ledgers: disclosed training records and stage counts; documented construction, feedback, and optimization procedures; publicly accessible model or service artifacts; and benchmark results. Evidence in one ledger does not complete another.

The official report describes a 56B-active, 560B-total hybrid Transformer-Mamba2-MoE model with 256K context. Its data-facing claims include 16T base pre-training tokens, 3M supervised fine-tuning samples, adaptive long-short reasoning traces, multi-model deliberation, human preference annotations for a Generative Reward Model, executable code with unit tests, and two GRPO stages. The audit question is not whether these stages are named, but whether a record can be connected to its source, generator, filtering decision, reward, training stage, and final checkpoint.

The checked official artifacts do not close that chain. Tencent publishes the arXiv report and an official GitHub repository containing the report, README, and figures. An official Hugging Face Space provides a hosted API demo. The GitHub repository does not contain the construction or training code, and the Space is not a downloadable weight repository. No official training dataset or Hunyuan-TurboS weight files were located on these surfaces. Benchmark scores consequently remain model-behavior evidence, not evidence that the training records, rights, or verifier decisions are reproducible.

一份前沿模型报告可以披露大量训练细节，却仍不公开独立审计所需的可复用对象。因此，阅读 Hunyuan-TurboS 时必须分开维护四本账：已披露的训练记录类型与阶段数量、已有文档的构造和反馈及优化流程、公众可访问的模型或服务工件，以及基准结果。任何一本账中的证据都不能替另一账补全缺口。

官方报告描述了一个激活参数 56B、总参数 560B、上下文长度 256K 的 Transformer-Mamba2-MoE 混合模型。与数据有关的披露包括 16T 基础预训练 token、300 万条监督微调样本、自适应长短推理轨迹、多模型 deliberation、用于 Generative Reward Model 的人工偏好标注、带单元测试的可执行代码，以及两个 GRPO 阶段。审计重点不是这些阶段是否被命名，而是能否把一条记录连接到其来源、生成器、筛选决定、奖励、训练阶段和最终 checkpoint。

已核验的官方工件没有补全这条链路。腾讯公开了 arXiv 报告，以及只包含报告、README 和图片的官方 GitHub 仓库；官方 Hugging Face Space 提供托管 API 演示。GitHub 仓库没有构造或训练代码，Space 也不是可下载权重仓库。在这些官方页面上没有找到训练数据集或 Hunyuan-TurboS 权重文件。因此，基准分数只能作为模型行为证据，不能证明训练记录、权利链或 verifier 决定可复现。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report combines an adaptive reasoning data path with a heterogeneous reward system. For reasoning SFT, Hunyuan-Base first attempts a short response. A correct attempt is retained; after an incorrect attempt, Hunyuan-T1 continues the reasoning until a correct answer is obtained. Failed attempts and the correct response are concatenated to train an adaptive long-short teacher, whose outputs supply the first Hunyuan-TurboS SFT stage. This is teacher-generated supervision, but the report does not name a separate final-model distillation stage or disclose a distillation-only corpus size.

The model then participates in a deliberation flywheel. Hunyuan-TurboS, Hunyuan Large, Hunyuan Turbo, and Hunyuan T1 answer the same curated prompts. Hunyuan-TurboS-based judges score pairwise outputs for accuracy, helpfulness, harmlessness, coherence, conciseness, and instruction adherence; consensus and human experts identify weakness profiles, which guide new expert-annotated SFT batches. Judge versions, scoring weights, prompt sets, iteration counts, and added-data totals are unknown.

Reinforcement learning is supported by a General Reward System spanning 16 subtopics and more than 30 scoring services. It combines a reference-conditioned GRM, GRM-CoT, an Answer Consistency Model, a tool-using critic, a 36-language sandbox, domain rules, classifiers, and score fusion. Stage I GRPO focuses on reasoning; Stage II expands to general instruction following. These are concrete report-level contracts, but not released reward checkpoints, per-sample reward vectors, or replayable rollouts.

报告把自适应推理数据路径与异构奖励系统结合起来。对于推理 SFT，Hunyuan-Base 先尝试生成短回答；若答案正确就直接保留，若首次回答错误，则由 Hunyuan-T1 继续推理，直到得到正确答案。失败尝试与正确回答会拼接起来，用于训练自适应长短推理 teacher，其输出再供 Hunyuan-TurboS 的第一阶段 SFT 使用。这属于 teacher 生成的监督，但报告没有把它命名为独立的最终模型蒸馏阶段，也没有披露仅属于蒸馏的数据规模。

随后，模型进入 deliberation 数据飞轮。Hunyuan-TurboS、Hunyuan Large、Hunyuan Turbo 和 Hunyuan T1 回答相同的精选提示；基于 Hunyuan-TurboS 的 judge 从准确性、有用性、无害性、连贯性、简洁性和指令遵循等维度评价成对输出，再由共识机制与人类专家形成弱点画像，据此增加专家标注的 SFT 批次。judge 版本、评分权重、提示集合、迭代次数与新增数据总量均为 unknown。

强化学习由覆盖 16 个子主题、超过 30 个评分服务的 General Reward System 支持。该系统组合参考答案条件下的 GRM、GRM-CoT、Answer Consistency Model、可调用工具的 critic、支持 36 种编程语言的沙箱、领域规则、分类器和分数融合。Stage I GRPO 聚焦推理，Stage II 扩展到通用指令遵循。这些是具体的报告级契约，但并非已发布的奖励 checkpoint、逐样本奖励向量或可重放 rollout。

title: Method
方法
html:
Pre-training is disclosed at stage level. Raw, varied-format sources undergo URL-level filtering and deduplication, block pruning, topic classification, text extraction, domain-specific STEM and code extraction, heuristic filtering, critique-model scoring, mixture modeling, and global semantic deduplication. The model is reported as trained on 16T base pre-training tokens. A subsequent annealing phase uses 300B tokens drawn from high-quality pre-training data, code, mathematics, STEM, instruction-following data including long reasoning traces, and other synthetic samples. Context extension then uses 30B tokens at 32K and 20B at 256K, with a 3:1 short-to-long ratio. Source names, mixture weights, record counts, dates, and rights are unknown.

SFT comprises 3M reasoning and non-reasoning samples. Mathematics comes from educational sources and uses generative reward models and verifiers; code converts open-source code into instructions and applies critic filtering and sandbox execution; logic mixes public or licensed sources with synthesis and tiered model or expert validation; science uses a reference-matching verifier; multilingual data uses augmentation, instruction evolution, back-translation, and human experts. Other domains include creative writing, complex instruction, role play, knowledge QA, multi-turn dialogue, finance, legal, medical, and nearly 1,000 safety categories. Domain proportions, exact sources, licenses, and accepted or rejected records are not released.

Adaptive long-short data generation retains correct Hunyuan-Base short responses. Failed responses are passed to Hunyuan-T1 for repeated continuation until a correct answer appears; all failed attempts and the correct response form the teacher target. Adaptive RL samples different reasoning depths, uses online rejection sampling to estimate difficulty, and applies a length penalty so equally correct shorter traces receive higher reward. Candidate counts, stopping caps, correctness verifier, and decoding settings are unknown.

Deliberation learning compares Hunyuan models on a curated training split, aggregates multi-dimensional Hunyuan-TurboS-based judge scores, and uses human experts to define weakness profiles and add targeted SFT batches. GRM training samples paired responses from multiple Hunyuan-TurboS checkpoints; humans label about 200K high-confidence pairs with reported agreement above 93 percent, and candidate order is swapped to reduce position bias. The annotation rubric, sampling frame, adjudication, and released pairs are unavailable.

The General Reward System includes reference-conditioned GRM, optional GRM-CoT, an Answer Consistency Model, a tool-using critic, a 36-language sandbox on a distributed CPU cluster, domain rules, and score fusion. More than 800K executable, unit-tested code samples are reported; six mainstream languages contribute 100K each, and long-tail languages contribute 10K each. The relation between these constructed code samples, SFT records, reward training, and RL prompts is not fully mapped.

Stage I GRPO uses 300K reasoning records mixed as Code:Mathematics:Logic-and-Science = 2:2:1. Stage II uses 160K general RL instructions and retains 10 percent Stage I reasoning data. The implementation uses token-level GRPO, approximate K3 KL clipped to [0,10], Best-of-N loss only for positive-advantage samples, dynamic sampling, temperature 1.0, removal of consistently solved or failed prompts and zero-advantage samples, and group reward adjustment. Learning rates, group sizes, complete rollout counts, reward weights, and checkpoint schedule are unknown.

预训练只披露到阶段层面。多格式原始来源依次经过 URL 级过滤与去重、块级裁剪、主题分类、文本抽取、面向 STEM 与代码的领域抽取、启发式过滤、critique 模型评分、混合建模和全局语义去重。报告称基础预训练使用 16T token。随后的 annealing 阶段使用 300B token，来源包括高质量预训练数据、代码、数学、STEM、含长推理轨迹的指令遵循数据和其他合成样本；上下文扩展阶段再分别在 32K 和 256K 长度使用 30B 与 20B token，短上下文与长上下文比例为 3:1。来源名称、混合权重、记录数、时间与权利均为 unknown。

SFT 包含 300 万条推理和非推理样本。数学来自教育资料，并使用生成式奖励模型与 verifier；代码把开源代码转成指令，并经过 critic 过滤与沙箱执行；逻辑混合公开或许可来源、自动合成以及分层的模型或专家验证；科学使用参考答案匹配 verifier；多语言数据通过文档增强、instruction evolution、回译与人工专家构造。其他领域包括创意写作、复杂指令、角色扮演、知识问答、多轮对话、金融、法律、医疗，以及近 1,000 个安全类别。领域占比、精确来源、许可和被接受或拒绝的记录均未发布。

自适应长短推理数据生成会保留 Hunyuan-Base 的正确短回答。失败回答交给 Hunyuan-T1 反复续写，直到出现正确答案；全部失败尝试与正确回答共同构成 teacher target。自适应 RL 采样不同推理深度，通过在线拒绝采样估计难度，并使用长度惩罚，使同样正确的较短轨迹获得更高奖励。候选数、停止上限、正确性 verifier 和解码设置均为 unknown。

deliberation learning 在精选训练 split 上比较多个 Hunyuan 模型，聚合基于 Hunyuan-TurboS 的多维 judge 评分，再由人类专家定义弱点画像并增加针对性 SFT 批次。GRM 训练从多个 Hunyuan-TurboS checkpoint 采样成对回答；人工标注约 20 万对高置信偏好，报告称标注者一致率超过 93%，并交换候选顺序以降低位置偏差。标注规范、采样框、裁决流程与标注对本身均未发布。

General Reward System 包括参考答案条件下的 GRM、可选 GRM-CoT、Answer Consistency Model、可调用工具的 critic、部署在分布式 CPU 集群上的 36 语言沙箱、领域规则和分数融合。报告称构造了超过 80 万条可执行、带单元测试的代码样本；六种主流语言各贡献 10 万条，长尾语言各贡献 1 万条。这些代码样本与 SFT 记录、奖励训练和 RL 提示之间的对应关系没有完整映射。

Stage I GRPO 使用 30 万条推理记录，Code:Mathematics:Logic-and-Science 的比例为 2:2:1。Stage II 使用 16 万条通用 RL 指令，并保留 10% 的 Stage I 推理数据。实现采用 token 级 GRPO、裁剪到 [0,10] 的近似 K3 KL、仅对正 advantage 样本启用的 Best-of-N loss、动态采样、温度 1.0、删除始终成功或失败的提示与零 advantage 样本，以及 group reward adjustment。学习率、group size、完整 rollout 数、奖励权重和 checkpoint 调度均为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is the official arXiv v3 report. It supports the 16T pre-training figure, 300B annealing stage, 30B and 20B context-extension stages, 3M SFT count, adaptive-teacher procedure, deliberation loop, about 200K human preference annotations, more than 800K executable code samples, 300K Stage I RL records, 160K Stage II instructions, 16-subtopic reward system, more than 30 scoring services, and RL temperature 1.0. These are report-level disclosures, not a released record inventory.

Tencent's official GitHub repository verifies a project surface and mirrors the technical report. Its checked root contains README.md, Hunyuan-Turbos_Report.pdf, and Figures/; it does not contain training code, model files, datasets, configuration files, or a license file. The official repository therefore supports citation and report availability, not code or weight release.

Tencent's verified Hugging Face organization hosts tencent/hunyuan-turbos as a public Space. Its small application calls Tencent's hosted Hunyuan API. The Space is operational evidence of a service demo, not a model repository: it does not expose Hunyuan-TurboS parameter shards, tokenizer files, a model card, or training data. Tencent Cloud documentation also lists hunyuan-turbos-latest as a hosted model service. Service access must not be described as open weights.

The report presents LMSYS Chatbot Arena results, a 77.9 percent average across 23 automated benchmarks, and a 6,000-prompt token-efficiency evaluation. Those results support claims about model behavior under the reported evaluation conditions. They do not verify record-level provenance, rights, reasoning validity, judge calibration, sandbox reproducibility, contamination controls, or the quality of unreleased data. The report does not provide controlled ablations that allocate the final behavior to every SFT, deliberation, reward, or RL component.

最强证据来自官方 arXiv v3 报告。它支持 16T 预训练 token、300B annealing 阶段、30B 与 20B 上下文扩展阶段、300 万条 SFT、adaptive teacher 流程、deliberation 循环、约 20 万条人工偏好标注、超过 80 万条可执行代码样本、30 万条 Stage I RL 记录、16 万条 Stage II 指令、覆盖 16 个子主题且包含超过 30 个评分服务的奖励系统，以及 RL 温度 1.0。这些都是报告级披露，并非已发布记录清单。

腾讯官方 GitHub 仓库验证了项目页面，并镜像技术报告。核验时其根目录只有 README.md、Hunyuan-Turbos_Report.pdf 和 Figures/，没有训练代码、模型文件、数据集、配置文件或许可文件。因此，该仓库能证明引用与报告可获取，不能证明代码或权重已经发布。

腾讯经过验证的 Hugging Face 组织托管了公开 Space tencent/hunyuan-turbos。这个小型应用调用腾讯托管的 Hunyuan API。该 Space 是服务演示的运行证据，不是模型仓库：其中没有 Hunyuan-TurboS 参数分片、tokenizer 文件、模型卡或训练数据。腾讯云文档也把 hunyuan-turbos-latest 列为托管模型服务。服务可调用不应被描述为开放权重。

报告给出 LMSYS Chatbot Arena 结果、23 个自动化基准上的 77.9% 平均分，以及一个 6,000 提示的 token 效率评测。这些结果只能支持模型在所述评测条件下的行为结论，不能验证记录级来源、权利、推理有效性、judge 校准、沙箱可复现性、污染控制或未发布数据的质量。报告也没有提供能够把最终行为完整归因到每个 SFT、deliberation、奖励或 RL 组件的受控消融。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The data-facing novelty is the disclosed composition of adaptive reasoning supervision, deliberation-driven data repair, and a broad multi-service reward layer. Correct short attempts are retained, failed attempts are extended by Hunyuan-T1, and the combined histories train a teacher that can choose between short and long reasoning. A multi-model competition then turns judge and expert findings into targeted SFT additions. Finally, two GRPO stages consume domain-specific rewards rather than one universal correctness signal.

The reward disclosure is unusually broad for a frontier report. Reference-conditioned generative judgment, binary answer consistency, tool-using critique, executable-code tests, classifiers, refusal heuristics, hallucination checks, action-level rules, and domain score fusion are described within one system. The report also gives separate counts for GRM human labels, executable code, and two RL stages, which helps prevent them from being collapsed into a single vague post-training corpus.

What is not new should remain explicit. SFT, teacher-generated data, rejection sampling, pairwise reward modeling, ensemble judging, sandbox execution, GRPO, KL regularization, and dynamic sampling all have precedents. The distinct contribution is their reported orchestration around an adaptive long-short model and large proprietary infrastructure, not a newly released dataset, verifier, or optimizer implementation.

For the atlas, this is a direction signal and a disclosure-ledger case, not proof of an open recipe. Its reuse value comes from the stage decomposition and feedback taxonomy. Full reproducibility still requires immutable records, source and rights manifests, generator and judge revisions, reward calibration, rejected outputs, executable environments, rollout histories, code, and weights.

从数据角度看，主要新意是把自适应推理监督、由 deliberation 驱动的数据修补和覆盖广泛的多服务奖励层组合起来并加以披露。正确短回答被保留，失败回答由 Hunyuan-T1 续写，合并后的历史用于训练能在短推理与长推理之间选择的 teacher；随后，多模型竞争把 judge 与专家发现转化为有针对性的 SFT 增量；最后，两个 GRPO 阶段使用分领域奖励，而不是单一的正确性信号。

对于前沿报告而言，奖励披露的覆盖面较广。参考答案条件下的生成式判断、二元答案一致性、工具辅助 critique、可执行代码测试、分类器、拒答启发式、幻觉检查、action-level 规则和领域分数融合都被放在同一系统中说明。报告还分别给出 GRM 人工标签、可执行代码和两个 RL 阶段的数量，有助于避免把它们压缩成一个含混的后训练语料总量。

同时必须说明哪些内容并不新。SFT、teacher 生成数据、拒绝采样、成对奖励建模、ensemble judge、沙箱执行、GRPO、KL 正则化和动态采样均已有先例。其独特贡献在于围绕自适应长短推理模型与大型专有基础设施进行的整体编排，而不是发布了新的数据集、verifier 或优化器实现。

对本图谱而言，它是一个方向信号与披露账本案例，而非开放配方的证明。可复用价值来自阶段拆分与反馈分类。要实现完整复现，仍需要不可变记录、来源和权利清单、生成器与 judge 版本、奖励校准、被拒输出、可执行环境、rollout 历史、代码与权重。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The source ledger is incomplete. The report describes broad pre-training and SFT source classes, but not source names for most material, collection dates, proportions, record identifiers, procurement terms, or a machine-readable rights matrix. URL-level and semantic deduplication do not establish benchmark decontamination, and no match or removal ledger is released.

The count ledger contains distinct, potentially overlapping objects. The 16T base pre-training tokens, 300B annealing tokens, 30B and 20B context-extension tokens, 3M SFT samples, about 200K preference labels, more than 800K executable code samples, 300K reasoning-RL records, and 160K general-RL instructions must not be summed. Their exact intersections, unique-record totals, mixture weights, repetitions, and checkpoint membership are unknown.

The adaptive-teacher path is not replayable. Exact Hunyuan-Base and Hunyuan-T1 checkpoints, generation instructions, candidate counts, temperatures, stopping caps, correctness verifier, compression transformation, and retained failed-attempt histories are unavailable. Reaching a correct final answer does not establish that every intermediate step is valid.

The deliberation and preference contracts are only partially specified. Judge models are said to be based on Hunyuan-TurboS and calibrated with experts, but versions, dimension prompts, consensus weights, calibration examples, disagreement rates, iteration counts, and weakness-profile records are not released. Agreement above 93 percent for about 200K preference labels is informative but cannot replace the annotation rubric, sampling frame, adjudication, and class distribution.

The reward system is broad but opaque. Checkpoints, training data, prompts, thresholds, weights, score distributions, calibration, false-accept rates, and per-record reward vectors for the GRM, GRM-CoT, Answer Consistency Model, critics, classifiers, and more than 30 services are unavailable. Reference errors, position bias, judge bias, score fusion, and reward hacking remain material risks.

The sandbox is not reproducible from the report. Thirty-six languages, distributed CPU execution, more than 1,000 concurrent runs, and file and network isolation are disclosed, but container images, compilers, packages, versions, resource limits, timeouts, unit-test sources, seeds, logs, and failure classifications are unknown. The more than 800K code samples are not released.

The RL runs cannot be replayed. Stage-level counts, mixture ratios, temperature 1.0, K3 clipping, positive-advantage Best-of-N loss, dynamic filtering, zero-advantage removal, and group adjustment are documented. Full prompt pools, rollout groups, sampled outputs, rewards, advantages, policy and reference revisions, optimizer state, learning rates, group sizes, and exact schedules are not.

The release surface is narrow. The official GitHub repository contains a report and figures rather than training code; the official Hugging Face Space is a hosted API demo rather than open weights. No official data files, reward checkpoints, sandbox package, Angel-RL implementation, or Hunyuan-TurboS weight shards were located on the checked official surfaces.

Finally, the reported benchmark and token-efficiency results are model evidence. They cannot establish data quality, provenance, rights compliance, process correctness, contamination absence, safety coverage, or verifier reliability.

来源账本不完整。报告描述了宽泛的预训练与 SFT 来源类别，却没有给出大多数材料的来源名称、采集日期、比例、记录标识、采购条款或机器可读的权利矩阵。URL 级与语义去重不能证明基准去污染，而且没有公开匹配或删除账本。

数量账本包含彼此不同且可能重叠的对象。16T 基础预训练 token、300B annealing token、30B 与 20B 上下文扩展 token、300 万条 SFT、约 20 万条偏好标签、超过 80 万条可执行代码、30 万条推理 RL 记录和 16 万条通用 RL 指令不能相加。它们的交集、唯一记录总数、混合权重、重复次数和 checkpoint 归属均为 unknown。

adaptive teacher 路径无法重放。精确的 Hunyuan-Base 与 Hunyuan-T1 checkpoint、生成指令、候选数、温度、停止上限、正确性 verifier、压缩转换和被保留的失败尝试历史均不可获得。最终答案正确并不能证明每个中间步骤有效。

deliberation 与偏好契约只得到部分说明。judge 据称基于 Hunyuan-TurboS 并由专家校准，但版本、维度提示、共识权重、校准样例、分歧率、迭代次数和弱点画像记录没有发布。约 20 万条偏好标签的一致率超过 93% 是有用信息，却不能替代标注规范、采样框、裁决过程与类别分布。

奖励系统覆盖广但不透明。GRM、GRM-CoT、Answer Consistency Model、critic、分类器和超过 30 个评分服务的 checkpoint、训练数据、提示、阈值、权重、分数分布、校准、误接受率和逐记录奖励向量都不可获得。参考答案错误、位置偏差、judge 偏差、分数融合与 reward hacking 仍是实质风险。

沙箱无法根据报告复现。报告披露了 36 种语言、分布式 CPU 执行、超过 1,000 个并发任务以及文件和网络隔离，却没有公开容器镜像、编译器、软件包、版本、资源限制、超时、单元测试来源、随机种子、日志和失败分类。超过 80 万条代码样本本身也没有发布。

RL 运行无法重放。报告说明了阶段数量、混合比例、温度 1.0、K3 裁剪、仅用于正 advantage 的 Best-of-N loss、动态过滤、删除零 advantage 样本和 group adjustment，但没有完整提示池、rollout group、采样输出、奖励、advantage、策略与参考模型版本、优化器状态、学习率、group size 或精确调度。

发布面很窄。官方 GitHub 仓库提供报告和图片，而非训练代码；官方 Hugging Face Space 是托管 API 演示，而非开放权重。在已核验官方页面上，没有找到官方数据文件、奖励 checkpoint、沙箱包、Angel-RL 实现或 Hunyuan-TurboS 权重分片。

最后，报告中的基准与 token 效率结果属于模型证据，不能证明数据质量、来源完整性、权利合规、过程正确性、无污染、安全覆盖或 verifier 可靠性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger, Hunyuan-TurboS is useful precisely because its disclosure is substantial but not open. The report permits a detailed stage table: base pre-training; annealing and context extension; 3M SFT; teacher-generated adaptive traces; deliberation-driven SFT additions; GRM preference labels; executable-code construction; Stage I reasoning GRPO; Stage II general GRPO; and evaluation. Each row can record its data object, generator, feedback contract, disclosed scale, official artifact, and unknowns.

Data builders can reuse the structural ideas without claiming to reproduce Tencent's corpus. Useful patterns include separating reasoning and non-reasoning SFT, retaining failed attempts for adaptive supervision, mapping each domain to an appropriate verifier, keeping preference labels distinct from RL prompts, maintaining executable environments for code, reporting per-stage counts, and documenting dynamic prompt filtering. A stronger implementation should also retain source IDs, rights, model revisions, generation settings, all candidates, rejection reasons, reward vectors, and run membership.

Auditors can test every ledger independently. For data, ask for immutable manifests and overlap accounting. For feedback, evaluate GRM and Answer Consistency Model calibration and stratify sandbox failures. For RL, request rollout groups, per-component rewards, and discarded prompt histories. For artifacts, inspect whether a repository contains runnable code, whether a model host contains parameter shards, and whether a demo only calls an external service. For evaluation, reproduce stated settings without treating the scores as data-quality labels.

The Card also prevents an important terminology error. Teacher-generated adaptive traces are disclosed, but a separately named final-model distillation stage and distillation-only data total are not. Similarly, access to hunyuan-turbos-latest through a service does not constitute open weights. Preserving those boundaries makes the report useful for comparative frontier-disclosure analysis.

对于 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger，Hunyuan-TurboS 的价值恰恰在于其披露丰富却并不开放。根据报告可以建立细致的阶段表：基础预训练、annealing 与上下文扩展、300 万条 SFT、teacher 生成的自适应轨迹、由 deliberation 驱动的 SFT 增量、GRM 偏好标签、可执行代码构造、Stage I 推理 GRPO、Stage II 通用 GRPO，以及评测。每一行都可记录数据对象、生成器、反馈契约、披露规模、官方工件与 unknown 项。

数据构建者可以复用结构思想，但不能声称复现了腾讯语料。可借鉴的做法包括分开推理与非推理 SFT、保留失败尝试用于自适应监督、为各领域匹配适当 verifier、把偏好标签与 RL 提示分账、为代码维护可执行环境、报告每阶段数量，以及记录动态提示过滤。更强的实现还应保留来源 ID、权利、模型版本、生成设置、全部候选、拒绝原因、奖励向量和运行归属。

审计者可以独立检查每一本账。对数据，应要求不可变 manifest 与重叠核算；对反馈，应评估 GRM 与 Answer Consistency Model 的校准，并分层分析沙箱失败；对 RL，应索取 rollout group、各奖励分量与被删除提示历史；对工件，应检查代码仓库是否真有可运行代码、模型托管页是否真有参数分片，以及演示是否只是调用外部服务；对评测，应复现所述设置，但不能把分数当作数据质量标签。

本 Card 还避免一个重要术语错误。报告确实披露了 teacher 生成的自适应轨迹，却没有独立命名最终模型蒸馏阶段，也没有给出仅属于蒸馏的数据总量。同样，通过服务调用 hunyuan-turbos-latest 不等于开放权重。保留这些边界，才能把该报告用于可比较的前沿披露分析。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the stage counts separate: 16T base pre-training tokens; 300B annealing tokens; 30B and 20B context-extension tokens; 3M SFT samples; about 200K GRM preference labels; more than 800K executable code samples; 300K Stage I RL records; and 160K Stage II instructions. They are not one additive corpus.
  • Adaptive supervision uses Hunyuan-Base short attempts and Hunyuan-T1 continuation after failures. Exact checkpoints, generation instructions, candidate counts, stopping caps, and correctness checks are unknown.
  • The General Reward System spans 16 subtopics and more than 30 services, including GRM, Answer Consistency Model, critics, sandbox execution, classifiers, rules, and score fusion. Checkpoints and calibration are not released.
  • The official GitHub repository is a report repository. The official Hugging Face Space is a hosted API demo. Neither is evidence of downloadable Hunyuan-TurboS weights or a released training corpus.
  • Treat benchmark and token-efficiency results as model-behavior evidence only; they do not validate provenance, rights, reasoning quality, verifier reliability, or decontamination.

• 分开记录各阶段数量：16T 基础预训练 token、300B annealing token、30B 与 20B 上下文扩展 token、300 万条 SFT、约 20 万条 GRM 偏好标签、超过 80 万条可执行代码、30 万条 Stage I RL 记录和 16 万条 Stage II 指令；它们不是一个可相加的语料总量。
  • 自适应监督使用 Hunyuan-Base 的短回答尝试，并在失败后由 Hunyuan-T1 继续生成；精确 checkpoint、生成指令、候选数、停止上限和正确性检查均为 unknown。
  • General Reward System 覆盖 16 个子主题和超过 30 个服务，包括 GRM、Answer Consistency Model、critic、沙箱执行、分类器、规则和分数融合；checkpoint 与校准没有发布。
  • 官方 GitHub 是报告仓库，官方 Hugging Face Space 是托管 API 演示；两者都不能证明 Hunyuan-TurboS 权重或训练语料可下载。
  • 基准与 token 效率结果只能作为模型行为证据，不能验证来源、权利、推理质量、verifier 可靠性或去污染。

value.html: Pre-training uses varied-format raw sources processed by URL filtering, block pruning, topic classification, content extraction, heuristics, and semantic deduplication, but the report does not name a complete source manifest. SFT sources are described by domain: educational mathematics, open-source code, public or licensed logic material, science questions, open-source and procured dialogue data, synthetic instructions, and expert-labeled finance, legal, medical, multilingual, and safety material. Record-level sources, proportions, dates, and rights are unknown.

The report describes problem-response SFT records with reasoning or direct responses, adaptive traces that can include failed attempts followed by a correct response, pairwise candidate answers with human preference labels for GRM training, reference answers, and executable code with unit tests. No downloadable training schema or row examples were located.

Hunyuan-Base produces initial short-CoT responses; Hunyuan-T1 repeatedly extends failed attempts until a correct response is obtained, after which failed attempts and the correct response are concatenated for an adaptive long-short teacher. Exact checkpoint identifiers, generation instructions, candidate budgets, stopping caps, and decoding settings are unknown.

value.html: Offline SFT, adaptive-CoT RL, multi-model deliberation, and two-stage GRPO run on proprietary Hunyuan infrastructure. The disclosed execution environment is a 36-language sandbox on a distributed CPU cluster supporting more than 1,000 concurrent executions with file and network isolation. Angel-RL integrates training and inference, but its implementation, dependency versions, and run configurations are not released here.

The General Reward System covers 16 subtopics through more than 30 scoring services. It combines a reference-conditioned Generative Reward Model, an optional GRM-CoT variant, an Answer Consistency Model, a tool-using critic, the multilingual code sandbox, classifiers, refusal heuristics, constraint and hallucination checks, domain rules, repetition penalties, and score fusion. Model checkpoints, prompts, service weights, thresholds, calibration sets, and error rates are mostly unknown.

Depending on the stage, acceptance can require answer-reference consistency, a unit-test outcome, a multi-judge or human preference decision, instruction-constraint satisfaction, or positive aggregate reward. Adaptive-teacher generation repeats Hunyuan-T1 continuation until a correct answer is obtained, while GRPO drops zero-advantage samples and consistently solved or failed prompts. Exact caps and retained decision records are unknown.

Hunyuan-TurboS is a 56B-active, 560B-total hybrid Transformer-Mamba2-MoE model with 128 layers and a 256K context window. The adaptive-teacher pipeline starts from Hunyuan-Base; exact downloadable checkpoint identifiers are unavailable.

Hunyuan-T1 extends incorrect short-CoT attempts. A separately trained adaptive long-short teacher generates first-stage SFT data. Hunyuan Large, Hunyuan Turbo, and Hunyuan T1 serve as competitors in deliberation learning, and a panel of Hunyuan-TurboS-based judges scores responses. Exact versions, prompts, and training corpora are unknown.

Domain pipelines collect, rewrite, procure, augment, back-translate, or synthesize instructions; models and experts construct responses; adaptive-CoT generation joins failed attempts with a correct solution; deliberation learning mines weakness profiles from pairwise model competition; and executable-code synthesis attaches unit tests before sandbox execution.

Adaptive-CoT RL samples responses with different reasoning depths and uses online rejection sampling to infer prompt difficulty. General GRPO uses dynamic sampling; RL response temperature is 1.0. Candidate counts per prompt, top-p, random seeds, maximum lengths, and most other decoding settings are unknown.
unknown
1.0 for RL response generation; unknown for other generation stages.

The report names URL-level filtering, block pruning, heuristic filtering, semantic deduplication, topic and quality models, critic and verifier checks, sandbox execution, human review, model consistency checks, online rejection sampling, difficulty-aware selection, exclusion of consistently solved or failed RL prompts, and removal of zero-advantage samples. Thresholds, yields, and rejected-record manifests are unknown.

Unknown for data construction and training rollouts. The report evaluates inference efficiency on a separate 6,000-prompt set with each request repeated five times, but that evaluation budget is not a training-data generation budget.

Two-stage token-level GRPO uses Angel-RL. Stage I mixes 300K reasoning records in a Code:Mathematics:Logic-and-Science ratio of 2:2:1. Stage II trains on 160K general RL instructions while retaining 10 percent Stage I reasoning data. The recipe clips approximate K3 KL to [0,10], applies Best-of-N loss only to positive-advantage samples, uses dynamic sampling, group reward adjustment, and a larger KL coefficient in Stage II. Exact learning rates, clip ranges other than K3, group sizes, epochs, and checkpoints are unknown.

The report states 16T base pre-training tokens, followed by a 300B-token annealing phase and long-context phases of 30B tokens at 32K and 20B tokens at 256K. Post-training disclosures include 3M SFT samples, about 200K high-confidence human preference annotations for GRM training with reported agreement above 93 percent, more than 800K executable unit-tested code samples, 300K Stage I reasoning-RL records, and 160K Stage II general-RL instructions. These quantities describe different objects and stages, may overlap, and must not be added into one corpus size.
unknown

Pre-training describes URL-level deduplication and global semantic deduplication. The checked report does not publish benchmark-specific match thresholds, benchmark revisions, overlap counts, removed-record ledgers, or a corpus-wide contamination audit for SFT, GRM, executable-code, deliberation, or RL data.

items: Aggregate counts cover different stages and may overlap; no immutable stage-to-record ledger reconciles them.
Teacher and judge checkpoints, generation instructions, decoding settings, candidate counts, stopping caps, and training-data lineage are incomplete.
Repeating Hunyuan-T1 generation until a correct endpoint may retain invalid intermediate reasoning; the stop cap and process-quality checks are unknown.

Reference-conditioned GRM, majority or weighted judge consensus, and Answer Consistency Model decisions can inherit reference errors, judge bias, or reward hacking; calibration and false-accept audits are not released.
Pairwise agreement above 93 percent is reported without the annotation rubric, sampling frame, adjudication protocol, or disagreement breakdown.
The 36-language sandbox is described operationally, but implementation, images, package versions, timeouts, unit-test provenance, and per-record execution logs are not released.
Dynamic prompt filtering changes the RL distribution over time, but retained and discarded prompt histories are unavailable.
URL and semantic deduplication do not establish benchmark decontamination or cross-source rights compliance.
The official GitHub repository is a report repository rather than training code, and the official Hugging Face Space calls a hosted API rather than distributing model weights.

Benchmark performance and token-efficiency measurements describe model behavior under stated evaluations; they do not prove training-record quality, provenance, rights, verifier accuracy, or contamination control.

The checked official GitHub root contains the report, README, and figures but no license file, and the official Hugging Face surface is an API demo rather than a weight or dataset license. None of these licenses establishes reuse rights for the unreleased training records.
